descriptionChirho: The proper noun עָפְרָה designating a city called Ophrah, primarily associated with Gideon's hometown in the territory of Manasseh (Judg 6:11, 6:24, 8:27, 8:32) and possibly also a town in Benjamin (Josh 18:23, 1 Sam 13:17). All three clusters are the identical toponym with different prepositional contexts. Multilingual evidence: English 'Ophrah/Ofrah,' Spanish 'Ofrá/Ofrah,' Hindi ओप्रा/आप्रा, Arabic عُفْرَة/عَفْرَة (consistent transliteration), Korean 오프라/오브라, Swahili Ofra. The locative 'in Ophrah' (S125524), directional/conjunctive 'to/and Ophrah' (S125525), and bare citation form (S125526) are purely syntactic variants of one place name.
